reviews.author: Sandeep Dangi
reviews.title: Good Quality product with prompt free service.
reviews.body: Good product by Godrej and good Service by it's technician. Fast and prompt service. Good Installation. Value for Money. Hopefully should be durable. Fitting was done free of cost although Product page said fitting charges are 499. There was a slight play in the inner handle which technician said is normal for all locks. As for instructions on how to use and set code and finger prints, etc., I suggest use chat gpt as technician can never fully explain everything properly.
